baseline: US national = 1.00 (BLS OEWS US national annual median wage, same release as metro values). Keystone currently applies a single Texas multiplier 0.95 to the national baseline.
method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.
release: BLS OEWS May 2024 (published 2025) via O*NET OnLine Texas local-wages pages for 47-2031, 47-2111, 47-2152, 47-2061, 49-9021 (US denominators from the same pages: 59,310 / 62,350 / 62,970 / 46,730 / 59,810). May 2025 national medians recorded for reference only.
